description: This file defines an enum 'ExecShellWrapperParser' that provides functionality to parse shell command invocations and determine if they are wrappers around different shell interpreters (like POSIX shells, Windows cmd, or PowerShell). It includes nested structs and enums for internal state management, and provides a static method 'extract' to analyze command arrays or raw command strings.

classes.name: ExecShellWrapperParser
classes.description: An enum acting as a namespace containing functions and nested types for parsing shell command wrappers

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Main entry point that determines if a command is a shell wrapper based on command array and optional raw command string

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Internal recursive function that processes command arrays, with depth control, to identify shell wrapper commands

methods.name: extractPayload
methods.description: Determines the payload (inner command) depending on shell type spec

methods.name: extractPosixInlineCommand
methods.description: Extracts inline command for POSIX shells from command array if flags match

methods.name: extractCmdInlineCommand
methods.description: Extracts inline command for Windows cmd shells from command array if /c flag is present

methods.name: extractPowerShellInlineCommand
methods.description: Extracts inline command for PowerShell shells from command array based on inline flags
